integrity: This package states original graph classification and counting arguments, provides two exhaustive finite corroborations, distinguishes known three-read special cases and does not claim independent mathematical audit.
scientific_limitations: Binary alphabet; exactly two substitutions in each of four distinct reads; n >= 5. Full all-n proof by graph types; the finite programs check n=5..9 only. Priority for unindexed equivalent classifications not independently established.
title: Four-read exact-two-substitution reconstruction: a complete graph classification
